# Phosphor Icons

This directory vendors the regular Phosphor Icons font from
[`@phosphor-icons/web` v2.1.1](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web/tree/v2.1.1).
The project and font are distributed under the MIT license; see `LICENSE.txt`.

The icon constants in `src/view/src/icons/rocprovfis_icon_defines.h` use the
stable codepoints published by Phosphor Icons. In this release, the visual
names “arrow out of box” and “arrow into box” correspond to the official
`arrow-square-out` and `arrow-square-in` glyph names.
